create_MoveForward_control: create a MoveForward SceneNodeControl class to move an agent forward along the Z axis
create_MoveBackward_control: create a MoveBackward SceneNodeControl class to move an agent backward along the Z axis
create_LookLeft_control: create a LookLeft SceneNodeControl class to rotate an agent left around the Y axis with optional constraints
create_LookUp_control: create a LookUp SceneNodeControl class to rotate an agent upward around the X axis with optional constraints
create_RotateSensorClockwise_control: create a RotateSensorClockwise SceneNodeControl class to rotate a sensor clockwise around the Z axis
